tool_args.rationale: The short-horizon gradient dependence and long-horizon reversal suggest that the siphon base and adaptation may interact rather than add independently. Numerically fit several explicit sink-coupled variants and submit the best training fit for fresh confirmation; the earlier confirmations do not establish its accuracy.

considered_alternatives.option: Additive siphon base plus gradient-independent dual-horizon response
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A previous confirmation refuted this mechanism, with confirmation RMSE 0.274193.
The previous candidate was refuted on fresh confirmation; nonlinear sink coupling is a distinct revision.
